notes.title: Demo Approved and Live!
notes.notes:
Great news! The game demo has been approved and is now available to play.

Thank you for your patience and support. You can now try the game and share your feedback. I hope you enjoy the experience!

notes.title: Game Page Now Live & Demo Incoming!
notes.notes:
Hello, everyone! I'm thrilled to announce that the game's Steam page is now live!

A special thank you to the 16 of you who have already added the game to your wishlist <3

I'm also excited to share that the demo has been submitted to Valve and is currently under review. If all goes well, it should be approved by the start of next week. Stay tuned!
